filter.rule: retain GO terms with supplied ontology height <= 1; exclude height >= 2
filter.stage: pre-training only; runtime predictions are never height-filtered

metric.limitation: Scores are descriptive held-out Filipe lexical cosine retrieval scores, not calibrated probabilities; benchmark results do not transfer to Henry.

preparation.dedup_protocol: exact normalized-text groups plus exhaustive char_wb TF-IDF [3,5] cosine >= 0.90 connected components; components split deterministically
preparation.filter_order: height <= 1 before entity join, split, candidate selection, and training
preparation.stage: pre-training only; runtime predictions are never height-filtered

promotion.rollback: select go-text@3.0.0 (inverted-height) or go-text@2.0.0 (depth) explicitly; immutable artifacts are never overwritten

provenance.source_artifact: accepted public-safe height<=1 and text-deduplicated research artifact

training.candidate_universe: GO labels observed in training only
training.provenance: accepted public-safe derived height<=1 and text-deduplicated artifact; no raw data, private extracts, or Henry data included
training.representation: word and char TF-IDF; equal-weight cosine to training-group GO centroids
